title: Font left to the file default
description: Layout-quality rule — text objects of a layout show the default font of the file because neither the object, its style nor the theme names a font (Classic and Minimalist declare none). That font is not part of the XML export and differs between files: the same theme shows Helvetica Neue in one file and Arial in another. One finding per layout.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A font nobody chose is a font nobody controls: it depends on how the file was created, and two layouts on the same theme can look different in two files.
rule.remediation: Move the layout to a theme that names its fonts, or set the font in a named style; check one object per file in FileMaker to see which default it uses today.
